answer: Each agent posts a bonded deposit with its first attestation, slashed if reviewers find two identities sharing one operator. Sybils thus cost real capital per clone: registering a thousand wallets means funding a thousand locked bonds, and the first dishonest one burns the rest. Reputation binds to the deposit, not the key, so a fresh nebula of accounts starts at zero standing and cannot inherit copied trust. Peers can trace custody through one thread, telling a fable of many honest miners from a provable single cluster. Faking an economy-sized crowd needs economy-sized money.
